or [file an issue](new) if you don't have time to do it now

title: Difference between noise_* and gen_* functions
description: Could you please be more specific regarding the difference in the frequence parameter. In the noise_* the default is 0.01 and in gen_* its 1. Even if you use the defaults it does not result with the sae pattern. In noise-* you need to apply normalize while in gen_* you probably don't

title: Fractal type in gen_perlin does nothing
description:
Changing the fractal type in gen_perlin does nothing:

```{r}
grid <- long_grid(seq(1, 10, length.out = 1000), seq(1, 10, length.out = 1000))
grid$noise1 <- gen_perlin(grid$x, grid$y, frequency = 0.5, fractal = "none", seed = 34563)
grid$noise2 <- gen_perlin(grid$x, grid$y, frequency = 0.5, fractal = "fbm", seed = 34563)
grid$noise3 <- gen_perlin(grid$x, grid$y, frequency = 0.5, fractal = "billow", seed = 34563)
grid$noise4 <- gen_perlin(grid$x, grid$y, frequency = 0.5, fractal = "rigid-multi", seed = 34563)
print(all(grid$noise1==grid$noise2))
[1] TRUE
print(all(grid$noise1==grid$noise3))
[1] TRUE
print(all(grid$noise1==grid$noise4))
[1] TRUE
```

title: tiled output
description:
![test_noise_1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25272594/91965690-23daf300-ed11-11ea-8cc7-7fa846734a4e.png)

Hi, I had a use case where I want the output of either Perlin or Simplex noise to be tiled. 
Is that possible with `ambient`?
I don't see relevant keywords in the [documentation](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/ambient/ambient.pdf) (eg. tiling, wrapping, seamless), but I might have missed it.

If not is that something that could be added? For example `libnoise`'s `noiseutils` has a tiling utility `enableSeamless`, so something like the image?

long_grid not work well for dplyr 1.0.0
description:
This probem was generated after update the dplyr to version 1.0.0

``` r
if (!require(ambient)) {
  remotes::install_github('thomasp85/ambient')
}

library(ambient)
library(dplyr)

z1 <- long_grid(1:100, 1:100)
class(z1)
#> [1] "long_grid"  "tbl_df"     "tbl"        "data.frame"
# error
mutate(z1)
#> Error in attributes(x) <- attrib: dims [product 20000] do not match the length of object [2]

# error, after coerce it to a data.frame directly
z2 <- long_grid(1:100, 1:100) %>% 
  as.data.frame()
mutate(z2)
#> Error in attributes(x) <- attrib: dims [product 20000] do not match the length of object [2]

# correct after remove the class attr and then coerce it to a data.frame using
# as.data.frame
z3 <- long_grid(1:100, 1:100) %>% 
  unclass() %>% 
  as.data.frame()
head(mutate(z3), 5)
#>   x y
#> 1 1 1
#> 2 1 2
#> 3 1 3
#> 4 1 4
#> 5 1 5

# error after remove the class attr and then coerce it to a tibble using
# as_tibble
z4 <- long_grid(1:100, 1:100) %>% 
  unclass() %>% 
  as_tibble()
mutate(z4)
#> Error in attributes(x) <- attrib: dims [product 20000] do not match the length of object [2]
```

title: Error in .Call("_ambient_gen_simplex2d_c" ,,,
description:
long_grid(x = seq(0, 10, length.out = 1000), 
          y = seq(0, 10, length.out = 1000)) %>% 
  mutate(
    x1 = x + gen_simplex(x, y) / 2, 
    y1 = y + gen_simplex(x, y) / 2,
    worley = gen_worley(x, y, value = 'distance', seed = 5),
    worley_frac = fracture(gen_worley, ridged, octaves = 8, x = x, y = y, 
                           value = 'distance', seed = 5),
    full = blend(normalise(worley), normalise(worley_frac), gen_spheres(x1, y1))
  )

gives

Error in .Call("_ambient_gen_simplex2d_c", PACKAGE = "ambient", x, y,  : 
  "_ambient_gen_simplex2d_c" not available for .Call() for package "ambient"
